summary: Beasley Broadcast Group filed a 424B5 for a registered direct offering of 200,000 Class A shares and pre-funded warrants for 157,000 shares to a single institutional investor, plus concurrent private placement warrants for 357,000 shares. Combined price is $14.00 per share or $13.9999 per pre-funded warrant, raising about $5.0 million before fees. Pre-funded warrants have a $0.0001 exercise price, are immediately exercisable, and carry a 4.99%/9.99% beneficial ownership blocker. Private warrants are exercisable at $15.00 beginning six months after issuance and expire in 5.5 years. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners is sole placement agent. This is a capital-raising event, not a capital return.
